implemented: TCG FOP stores ((primary opcode & 7)<<8)|ModRM alongside the existing non-control FIP update; FNINIT/FNSAVE reset FOP. This deliberately selects legacy fopcode-compatibility style (every completed non-control x87 instruction), not a claim to model every Intel generation IA32_MISC_ENABLE mode.
Waiting x87 instructions test prior pending exceptions before memory/provenance changes; the six FN controls remain non-waiting. FNSTSW AX no longer replaces the prior instruction provenance.

FNSTENV stores the pre-mask environment then masks all six exceptions and recomputes ES/B; FLDCW and FLDENV recompute ES/B from status exception flags and loaded masks. Existing CR0.NE/FERR handling is reused.

32-bit protected/compatibility 28-byte FNSTENV/FLDENV include FOP, FIP, FDP, FCS, FDS. FLDENV uses MMU_DATA_LOAD rather than STORE. FRSTOR/FNSAVE inherit the environment fixes. 64-bit REX-prefixed legacy environment operations retain 28-byte size rather than accidentally preparing 56 bytes.

FXSAVE/FXRSTOR and XSAVE/XSAVEOPT/XRSTOR carry explicit instruction operand-size mode through decoder/helper calls. Non-REX.W format has 32-bit offsets and 16-bit selectors; REX.W format has full-width offsets, and Intel-defined REX.W restore clears FCS/FDS. FOP is explicitly written/read (11-bit mask). Linux-user signal wrappers select target ABI width.
64-bit memory x87 FDP records the linear address including FS/GS base; non-64-bit FDP retains segment-relative offset.

Shared inline cpu_x86_fptag(const CPUX86State *) returns physical full tag classifications from empty mask and exact 80-bit payload; FNSTENV and GDB tag export use it. GDB writes distinguish empty/nonempty, per modern x87 semantics.

GDB individual ST(i) writes use physical[(TOP+i)&7], matching reads, and use unaligned-safe byte loads. FOP/selector fields are no longer placeholders. GDB FIP/FDP XML remains unsupported/placeholder explicitly; it is not a canonical-state source.
XSAVEOPT emitter now invokes its existing XSAVEOPT helper while forwarding pointer-layout mode.

correction_to_prior_review.correction: The prior concern that modern FLDENV/FRSTOR must preserve arbitrary nonempty full-tag classifications was incorrect. Intel explicitly loads only empty/nonempty and classifies the actual payload on save. No full-tag shadow state is added; no CPUX86State layout or migration ABI change.

required_parent_tests: Build fixed source+patch; pin configure/compiler/dependencies/final ELF SHA. Reject warning/error or unexpected source changes.
A5-filled FXSAVE plus FNSTENV for known nonzero FADD/FOP and nonzero offset/selectors: compare raw data and stopped QMP state, physical tags and logical ST order. Verify FNINIT clears FOP.

Roundtrip FXRSTOR and FLDENV with nonzero FOP/pointers/selectors, multiple TOP values, holes, signed zero, finite, subnormal, infinity/NaN/unsupported 80-bit payload. Read-only FLDENV page must succeed.

64-bit code with >4GiB FIP/FDP including FS/GS-base operand; distinguish REX.W=0 and REX.W=1 layouts and clear-selectors restore behavior. Compatibility code must select the 32-bit image. Do not treat architectural 32-bit save-format truncation as a full64 capture.

Pending-state fixture loaded by FLDENV: FNSTENV succeeds/stores old masks then prevents FWAIT fault; FLDCW unmasks a preexisting flag and the following waiting instruction traps before data/provenance changes. FNSTSW AX and other FN controls preserve provenance. CR0.NE=1 primary scope.
FXRSTOR/XSAVE/XRSTOR roundtrips require their own bounded tests; passing FXSAVE alone is insufficient. Snapshot restore must preserve hidden caches/events/resources via separate contract.
Individual GDB ST writes at TOP!=0 check logical slot mapping only; bulk G packet and pointer XML are not certified by that check.
remaining_blockers: CURRENT-INSTRUCTION unmasked x87 exception result/store/pop suppression is not repaired. Existing arithmetic helpers can commit a result before pending exception delivery; Windows/full57 continuation stays rejected.

Real-mode/v8086 packed legacy environment pointer/opcode formats are not implemented by this patch; protected 16-bit FOP-load policy is unverified and retained. Do not admit those modes from these tests.

CPU-model-specific FOP exception-only versus legacy compatibility mode is not implemented. CPUID FDP_EXCPTN_ONLY/ZERO_FCS_FDS or forced unsupported feature combinations are not certified. Use pinned feature profile with those bits clear.

Control-word reserved-bit normalization, stack under/overflow and all unmasked arithmetic cases, MMX pending exception behavior, page/MMIO fault atomicity, invalid-opcode exception priority, and MXCSR-reserved-bit FXRSTOR #GP atomicity remain outside this patch.
GDB FIP/FDP are still zero placeholders; GDB bulk G writes that also change TOP are not a full-state restore protocol. Use typed full-width stopped-state QMP export for provenance.
CPU migration omits FCS/FDS in the stock VMState; this patch does not change that ABI. Stock savevm/migration therefore cannot be certified as full-state save/restore.
No DR4/DR5 semantics, all-vCPU stop epoch proof, hidden state restore, devices/RAM/resource ownership, original Windows/WOW64 or original-game acceptance is established.
